capability_declaration.rationale: CIM (IEC 61970/61968/62325) models exchange of static power-system data — no concept of agent-initiated capability declaration exists in any CIM profile.

bounded_authority.rationale: CIM is a semantic data model, not an authorization framework. It defines no clauses for operational limits, scope boundaries, token expiry, or override mechanisms.

decision_auditability.rationale: CIM provides no logging, attribution, or audit-trail semantics. IEC 62325 market profiles assume external settlement processes for accountability.

data_governance.rationale: CIM contains no provisions on data ownership, consent, retention, or privacy — it is a structural modelling standard, not a governance one.
